title: Beyond Top-$k$ Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.05824v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, but routing user requests over large skill registries is difficult because many skills are functionally redundant while complex tasks often require complementary skill sets. Existing skill routers typically rank candidates independently by query relevance, which can waste context budget on redundant skills. We propose Diverse Skill Routing (DSR), a diversity-aware reranking framework that uses a Determinantal Point Process to balance relevance and non-redundancy. DSR introduces a query-residual diversity kernel that penalizes redundant skill overlap while reducing penalties caused only by shared query relevance. On the SkillRouter benchmark, DSR improves recall and full coverage over a strong pointwise reranking baseline, with larger gains on multi-skill queries. translated_title: 超越Top-$k$技能检索：面向大语言模型智能体的多样性感知技能路由
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.05824v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖外部技能，但在大型技能注册表上路由用户请求十分困难，因为许多技能在功能上是冗余的，而复杂任务往往需要互补的技能组合。现有的技能路由器通常按查询相关性独立地对候选技能进行排序，这可能将上下文预算浪费在冗余技能上。我们提出了多样性技能路由（Diverse Skill Routing, DSR），这是一个多样性感知的重排序框架，利用行列式点过程来平衡相关性与非冗余性。DSR引入了一种查询残差多样性核，在惩罚冗余技能重叠的同时，减少仅由共享查询相关性引起的惩罚。在SkillRouter基准测试中，DSR相比强大的逐点重排序基线提升了召回率和完全覆盖率，且在多技能查询上提升更为显著。这些结果表明，技能路由不仅应被视为相关性排序问题，还应被视为组合问题（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出基于行列式点过程的多样性感知技能路由框架DSR，通过查询残差多样性核在重排序中平衡相关性与非冗余性，避免上下文预算浪费在冗余技能上，显著提升多技能查询的召回率和完全覆盖率。
en_tdlr: DSR is a diversity-aware skill reranking framework that uses a Determinantal Point Process with a query-residual diversity kernel to balance relevance and non-redundancy, improving recall and full coverage over pointwise reranking baselines, especially on multi-skill queries.
